title: Silent triangle UFO in Florida

tellings.quote: I'm looking at a triangle with the lights.

plain: In Florida in 2019, the author Peter Levenda, who writes about occult history and intelligence agencies, says he saw a silent triangle-shaped object with lights on it: "I'm looking at a triangle with the lights." He tells Michels he saw it himself, and brings in a man he calls Tom in the account. To him it is a personal sighting of the kind of craft others have reported for decades.
